title: Contract Requirement for Irreversible/Amplified Effect
source: Paper 8 v0.2, section 5, N11, pages 8–9; demo06_irreversible_requires_contract
requirement: Irreversible or high-impact paths require explicit governing conditions; reject operations lacking those conditions.
coverage: N11a contract requirement through real Kingpin lease checks. Scope, nonce/epoch invalidation and envelope checks are this runtime's contract-validity profile. N11b amplification measurement is not covered.

title: Evidence Supports Decision
source: Paper 8 v0.2, section 5, N21, pages 11–12; demo11_evidence_supports_decision
requirement: Decisions must be supported by their evidence; contradictory claims must not be treated as supported.
coverage: Checks actual CDE/Kingpin/lease evidence against gateway permission and explicit fixture expectations. This harness does not implement the original paper's separate contradiction-detector demo.

title: Reflex Forwards, Governance Decides
source: Paper 8 v0.2, section 5, N24, pages 12–13; demo19_reflex_forwards_governance_decides
requirement: Forwarding a signal alone must not authorize action; governance independently decides.
coverage: Governance half only, exercised with real CDE upstream forwarding. No Reflex implementation exists here: Reflex-specific proof/break conformance is not claimed.
